_doc: Frontmatter mapping for forge-export (ANY-MODEL-PLAN L2). Source of truth stays .claude/agents and .claude/skills. Keys never live here.

model._note: null = key omitted, OpenCode then uses the user's configured default model.

tools._note: A tool group present in the agent's tools list -> allow, absent -> deny (OpenCode permission block). Codex gets a sandbox hint: any edit/bash -> workspace-write, else read-only.

limits: no hooks (hard gates, scribe, stop obligations, resume brief)
